name: Switch 4 lines BYOD - Extra 2.0 family price and mixing plans
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: tired but friendly dad.
scripted_messages: Hello. Long day, so I'll get right to it. I've got four lines on Verizon (me, my wife and our two kids) and I'm thinking of moving everyone to AT&T on Extra 2.0. We'd keep our own phones, they're all unlocked. Your site says $160 a month for four lines, and something about $5 off for the first year per new line. What would we pay each month during year one and after that? I'm only comparing tonight.
Take your time, I'm in no hurry, tyt
Okay thanks. So after the first year it goes back up to the full $160, right?
Got it. Is that $160 after the AutoPay discount already, or would that come on top?
Alright. One more, can one of the four lines be on Premium 2.0 for me and the other three stay on Extra 2.0 without losing the four-line price?
That works for us. I know the monthly number isn't tiny, but you've been patient with a tired dad and I really appreciate it.
No, that covers it. Thanks again, have a good night, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 7: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 8: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 9: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
